scientific_question: Does independently GPS-tracked nestling white-stork 2014 migration cohort retain within-day-centered ellipsoid-altitude individual identity at same 50km migration grain and fixed date/age null as Rotics 2013?

result.scientific_effect_size_identification: A negative null-relative effect in this cohort, not a 95% equivalence or proof no biological identity.

source_independence.shared_device_deployment_context: One tag appears on distinct animals across 2013 and 2014 source databases. The 2014 focal 11 birds do not include the tag-2750 bird, based on their archived IDs. Thus distinct bird identities are confirmed at the literal ID level but study ecosystems are not automatically independent.
source_independence.caveat: One tag reuse in the full source references is not a within-individual cross-tag calibration or an independent instrument experiment.

supported: The fixed 50km daily-centered individual-identity statistic fails the one-sided positive null-reference test in this separately tracked, nestling-only white stork sample.
The original 2013 Rotics positive does not reproduce uniformly across white-stork sources with different cohort structure.
Despite 5km shared-cell support 0 in both sources, 50km gives nominally analyzable cohorts in both; movement geometry and tag sampling differ across cohorts.
not_supported: There is no individual altitude individuality in nestling storks: non-support is not an equivalence test and n=11/33 bird-days is limited.
A stage-specific biological mechanism causing the difference between 2013 and 2014 cohorts.
A significant 2013-vs-2014 interaction was statistically tested.
Tag/error/topography differences were controlled causally; tag/bird identity is one-to-one within 2014 study.
A universal across-taxon individual specialization law, independent of age, migration corridor, weather or measurement.
This 2014 result directly addresses 2016–2017 gull wind-dependent vertical use; that is a distinct estimand.
interpretation.final_note: Do not retune the predeclared 50km to descriptive 100km, don't drop 2014 from comparative sample, and don't repeat test with several source years to search for positive result.
